businessContact.emailStatus: submissions@brumradio.com is a first-party, official-domain, purpose-labelled music-submission mailbox. General, press, advertising/partnership and recruitment mailboxes were verified and excluded.

formBoundary.manualRecheckReason: The form requires direct audio upload and a content certification. A human must recheck the live workflow for dynamic anti-spam or protected controls, inspect the final file and make the radio-friendly declaration personally.

activityVerification.evidence: Brum Radio maintains a 2026 live-player surface, a populated current show directory and weekly schedule, active submission guidance, and a recent Music Team recruitment page describing responsibility for listening to new submissions and managing the station playlist.

genreFitEvidence: The official show directory includes Electronic, Chill, Indie, Reggae, Soul, World, DJ Mix and Eclectic categories.
Named specialist programmes include Algo|Afro Futures, Beauty in the Beats, Electric Soup, Find Your Happy Bass, WorldBeatUK, Roots 2 Love, Ruffer N Tuffer and experimental or alternative shows.
One clean MarcsMusic electronic, reggae, bass, ambient or world-fusion track has plausible specialist-show fit, subject to human programme selection.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: The route is first-party and free as published, but the main playlist is geographically restricted, MarcsMusic would be considered only for specialist shows, the form requires direct audio upload and a clean-content declaration, and international eligibility, upload-size, detailed WAV, rights, release-window and AI-origin rules remain unresolved.
